## Problem and expected behavior

Describe the result you expected and what happened.

## Reproduction

Include the exact command, small synthetic pre-commit configuration, output and error message.
Remove all secrets. For undisclosed vulnerabilities use SECURITY.md.

## Environment

Addon commit, Ruby version, host OS and Empeira version (if used).
Include Docker/Podman version, hook status and image build output.

## Before submitting

- [ ] I searched existing issues.
- [ ] The example contains no production data or secrets.
